about: Hand-picked courses from official provider pages. Each link, title, level and length was checked on the date above (by status and title where a site allows it, otherwise by reading the page). Hours are the provider's own figure, rounded; 'hoursEstimate' marks Bridge's estimate where the provider gives none. 'paid' means a subscription or fee for the full course (Coursera offers a free trial and financial aid). Prices change.
